input.request: Analyze these observations, run a separate native goal and create a source-honest explorer
Analyze these observations, run a separate native goal and create a source-honest explorer

Create a responsive evidence explorer for the real source FILE inputs/source.json written by Java. Load it with await (await fetch('inputs/source.json')).json(); no source globals exist. Use text heading #title, digit-only text #row-count, input #filter and button #reset. #filter matches exact case-sensitive series values; empty shows every row. Reset clears it. Use this exact semantic structure: source tr/td rows
seriestime_sposition_msource_kind
. The data-table ID belongs on TABLE itself, NEVER on tbody, a row or a div. Header text must be EXACTLY series, time_s, position_m, source_kind in that order: do NOT title-case, rename or add units to these th cells. Explain units in a separate caption. Render cells by iterating sourceData.headers, never Object.values(row), because object key order is not the declared CSV column order. Table #data-table tbody must render EVERY original row in original order, one td per source.headers entry in that exact order, using unchanged source string cells via textContent; no rounding, extra columns, pagination or invented values. Render two visible SVG polylines in the SAME svg with viewBox='0 0 800 300': data-series='native_actual' and data-series='native_prediction'. Use only those source rows for their respective line, in original order. For each point t=Number(row.time_s),p=Number(row.position_m): x=40+720*t/1.5,y=260-220*p/1.8. Keep at least3 decimals. A POLYLINE uses its points attribute with space-separated x,y pairs: polyline.setAttribute('points',pairs.map(([x,y])=>x.toFixed(3)+','+y.toFixed(3)).join(' ')). NEVER set a path d attribute on a polyline: it renders nothing and yields zero SVG points. Do not chart observation rows in that native graph. Add meaningful labelled axes and a legend. Native SVG only, no libraries/CDNs. Show this exact visible text in #scope: Observation data and a separate native simulation. No physical calibration or causal equivalence is claimed. Show exact text #data-quality: Within declared thresholds. Text #endpoint-error must be 0.024574 (m); text #prediction-error must be 0.000523 (m). These are text elements, not inputs. Layout is independently tested at780px and390px. Use normal semantic table layout: thead and tbody stay table groups, th are sticky within an overflow-auto wrapper; NEVER position thead absolutely or set tbody display:block.
